learningObjectives: Trace major ascending and descending pain pathways.
Apply predictive and behavioural mechanisms to persistent pain.

anatomy.label: Peripheral nociceptors
anatomy.detail: Transduce mechanical, thermal and chemical danger signals.
anatomy.clinical: Sensitisation lowers activation thresholds after injury.

anatomy.label: Spinal dorsal horn
anatomy.detail: Local circuits amplify or inhibit incoming nociceptive signals.

anatomy.label: Thalamus
anatomy.detail: Routes information to sensory, affective and arousal systems.
anatomy.clinical: Altered thalamocortical processing may contribute to persistent pain.

anatomy.label: Insula and cingulate
anatomy.detail: Integrate bodily state with emotional significance and action urgency.
anatomy.clinical: Threat appraisal can amplify suffering and avoidance.

anatomy.label: Periaqueductal grey
anatomy.detail: Coordinates endogenous inhibition and defensive responses.
anatomy.clinical: Reduced inhibition can permit greater spinal transmission.

interaction.instruction: Select a component, then run the sequence.

stages.label: Transmit
stages.text: Spinal pathways relay and transform signals.

stages.label: Interpret
stages.text: Brain networks integrate sensation, context and prediction.

stages.label: Modulate
stages.text: Descending systems amplify or inhibit transmission.

stages.label: Learn
stages.text: Avoidance and expectation update future threat responses.

quizBank.question: Nociception refers to:
options: Neural encoding of potentially harmful stimuli
quizBank.explanation: Nociception is neural threat signalling; pain is the conscious protective experience.

quizBank.question: Persistent pain can continue after tissue healing because of:
quizBank.explanation: Neural sensitivity and prediction can maintain pain without ongoing tissue injury.

quizBank.question: Descending pain pathways can:
quizBank.explanation: Descending modulation is bidirectional and context dependent.

quizBank.question: Allodynia means:
options: Pain from a normally non-painful stimulus
quizBank.explanation: Allodynia reflects altered processing of ordinarily innocuous input.

quizBank.question: The best clinical stance is to:
options: Validate pain while assessing maintaining mechanisms
Dismiss symptoms when scans are normal
quizBank.explanation: Validation and mechanism-based formulation are compatible and clinically essential.

reviewPrompts: Persistent pain can continue after tissue healing because of:
Pain is real even when ongoing tissue damage is absent. The clinically useful question is what mechanisms are sustaining protection now.
